inputs.text: This “machine-gun conversion” rationale is the cover story. The real move is to make a new design mandate—and criminal penalties—feel normal, so officials can widen control over what people are allowed to buy. And the message conveniently stops before saying exactly what the penalties cover. That silence isn’t reassuring; it’s how they keep the plan’s reach hidden until enforcement is in place.
